attacker_pocs.name: proto_order
attacker_pocs.why: A proto insertion command lists two valid unregistered prototypes in reverse creation order. The new membership check accepts both, but the first transfer removes the wrong unregistered list entry. A proto remains in both ownership lists and graph teardown dereferences it after freeing it.

role_a_rationale: The patch rejects proto insertion when a command's prototype is absent from the graph's unregistered list, preventing the described malformed command from registering an invalid pointer. It uses an index-based removal that assumes the command and graph lists have the same order; valid insertions in another order leave one prototype owned twice and cause a heap-use-after-free during graph destruction. The change is confined to the existing proto transfer path and preserves ordinary single-proto insertion behavior.
